title: Dashboard page
summary: A dashboard of widgets, each a pk-card holding a pk-stat or pk-chart, optionally grouped into tabs and headed sections, with an optional filter bar. Set the load(key) callback as a property (business logic, never config data): it is called with this bound to the page element, once per widget and independently, and resolves to the data merged onto that widget's element (a pk-stat's value/delta/tone/values, or a pk-chart's data/caption). A widget in a tab loads the first time that tab is shown, never before and never again on a revisit. Each widget is its own async boundary through its card's state: loading, the content once it resolves, or an error with Retry on rejection - one slow or rejecting widget never blocks or breaks another. The current filter selections are on this.context (read them inside load); changing a filter reloads every widget that has already loaded.

props.name: config
props.description: { tabs?, widgets, sections?, filters?, empty? }. widgets is [{ key, tab?, label, kind: 'stat'|'chart', empty? }][] - key is passed to load(key), tab is the id of the tab it belongs to (the first tab when missing or unknown), label is the card heading and the pk-stat label or pk-chart caption, kind picks the composed element (default stat), empty is { heading?, description? } shown in the card when there is no load callback. tabs is [{ id, label }][]; without tabs every widget renders in one ungrouped grid, in array order. sections is [{ heading?, tab?, widgets: string[] }][] naming the keys each groups, scoped to a tab (a tab with no section lists all its widgets). filters is [{ key, type: 'text'|'email'|'number'|'date'|'select', label, options? }][], the same shape as pk-list-page's, drawn as a bar above the tabs. empty is { heading?, description? } shown in place of everything when widgets is empty. Breaking change: this replaces the earlier config.tiles shape, with no alias. Optional title bar from the shared page shell: heading?: string, breadcrumb?: [{ label, href? }], actions?: [{ key, label, href?, variant?, hint? }] (a hint shows as a tooltip on the button) (an action without href fires pk-action). Nothing is drawn when none is set.

props.name: context
props.description: The current filter selections as a plain object keyed by filter key ({} with nothing selected; an empty selection is dropped). Read it inside load(key); changing a filter reloads every widget that has already loaded.

events.name: pk-action
events.description: A title-bar action (config.actions entry without an href) was clicked.

parts.name: header
parts.description: The shared title bar: a pk-page-header with the breadcrumb and actions from config. Hidden when config sets none of heading, breadcrumb or actions.

parts.name: filters
parts.description: The filter bar: one pk-input or pk-select per config.filters entry. Hidden when there are no filters.

parts.name: body
parts.description: Holds the pk-tabs strip (a pk-tab and pk-tab-panel per tab) when config.tabs is set, or every section directly when there are no tabs. A section is an optional section-heading around a grid of widget pk-cards.

a11y: Tab semantics (tablist, arrow keys, roving tabindex) come from pk-tabs. Each widget's loading and error states are announced by its own pk-card (pk-skeleton and pk-alert roles), scoped to that widget alone; a resolved widget is a real pk-stat or pk-chart with its own accessible name.

examples.title: Tabs, widgets and a filter (set config and load from script: an inline script cannot run under this site's CSP, so wire it the way pk-tool-page's run is wired)
